youtube_title: Sending You Money? Then Why Your UPI PIN? #Shorts
youtube_description:
You NEVER need a UPI PIN to receive money. PIN = money going out. Scammers send a QR or request saying 'enter PIN to receive' and your money leaves instead. India recorded 13.42 lakh UPI fraud cases in FY 2023-24 (govt data in Parliament). Scammed? Call 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline) immediately.
Source: MoS Finance reply in Parliament, Dec 2025.
Education only, not financial advice.
